verdicts.title: Disjointness through the Lens of Vapnik-Chervonenkis Dimension: Sparsity and Beyond
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The disjointness problem - where Alice and Bob are given two subsets of $\{1, \dots, n\}$ and they have to check if their sets intersect - is a central problem in the world of communication complexity.
